note: Bibliographic coverage of the two Walker volumes, as a citation layer for election-provenance.json. This file records WHICH CONTESTS EACH VOLUME COVERS and nothing else: no results, no page images, no text from either book. The volumes are in copyright (Royal Irish Academy) and are not published by this project; only these citations are. Coverage ranges are taken from each volume's own contents page. A contest matching a rule is cited, not verified: the volume demonstrably covers that body and date, but the figures have not been checked page by page against it.

volumes.title: Parliamentary Election Results in Ireland, 1801-1922
volumes.series: A New History of Ireland, Ancillary Publications II

rules.section: Results of general elections and by-elections, 1801-1918
rules.note: Covers every Irish seat at Westminster for the whole period. Civgraph's earliest Westminster contest is 1885-11-24, so the volume reaches back further than the data does.
Civgraph files the 1918 general election under dail-eireann because its returned members formed the First Dail. Walker tabulates the same contest as a United Kingdom general election.

excluded.note: Bodies and periods neither volume covers, recorded so the gap is deliberate rather than forgotten.
periods: Any contest after 1992: the later volume stops at the 1992 United Kingdom general election.
Northern Ireland Assembly elections from 1998 onward: the 1992 volume covers only the 1973-5 and 1982-6 assemblies.

Seven scans are missing from the 1918-92 volume (pages 2, 12, 40, 42, 96, 98, 278), four of which are the final results page of a section. Citations here are to the published volume, not to the incomplete scan set, so they stand regardless; but figures cannot be checked against those pages until they are sourced.
